items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1974-01-01
items.q: Hershel and the team team happened to be there. They asked me if I hadn't been musicians.

ctx.x: And I was gonna leave. Oh, he said you just like the rest of these three holes. You're not going anywhere. I can't.

Well, I always wanted to, I left on a challenge. I told my father-mother I was, I was bragging more than anything else. And I was going to leave, oh, you say you just like the rest of these people, you're not going anywhere. So that was the challenge. And I was always lucky that I thanked him for that. And these fellas came to New Orleans to the baseball team, to fix the seedlings. And Hershel and the team team happened to be there. They asked me if I hadn't been musicians. I told them I hadn't passed. And they…
They were all available, but how many wanted to leave?
